name: Demand Refusal 1
definition: Information about the refusal of a demand.

UndertakingIdentification.name: Undertaking Identification
UndertakingIdentification.definition: Details related to the identification of the undertaking.

AdvisingPartyReferenceNumber.name: Advising Party Reference Number
AdvisingPartyReferenceNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the advising party to the undertaking.

SecondAdvisingPartyReferenceNumber.name: Second Advising Party Reference Number
SecondAdvisingPartyReferenceNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the second advising party to the undertaking.

ConfirmerReferenceNumber.name: Confirmer Reference Number
ConfirmerReferenceNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the confirmer to the undertaking.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Expicit indication of 'REFUSED' as the processing status reported by the issuer.

DispositionOfDocuments.name: Disposition Of Documents
DispositionOfDocuments.definition: Indication of how the demand presentation documents will be handled as a consequence of the demand refusal.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information related to the notification.
